audience: sales and support teams that handle calls, transcripts and contacts in Ringover

useCases.title: Review calls and their AI summaries
useCases.text: List the calls of the last 15 days, then open one call to read its transcript and its AI summary.

useCases.title: Search call transcripts for a topic
useCases.text: Search the transcriptions by text, date or duration, then read the key moments of a call that matches.

useCases.title: Check who can take a call now
useCases.text: List the team presences, phone numbers and IVR menus to see who is available and which numbers exist.

useCases.title: Review SMS conversations
useCases.text: List the SMS and chat conversations, then read the messages of one conversation.

useCases.title: Add a lead to the address book
useCases.text: Search the contacts for the name first, then create a contact with its phone numbers in the team address book.
